content.text:
No. If you post a link now, X, LinkedIn, Slack and the others will show the title and description, but no image.

The metadata in [layout.tsx](src/app/layout.tsx:10) has only `title`, `description` and `icons`. The app has no `openGraph`, `twitter` or `metadataBase` settings and no `opengraph-image` file.

To fix it:

- **Add an image file:** put an `opengraph-image.png` (1200×630) in `src/app/`. Next.js adds the `og:image` and `twitter:image` tags on its own. You could also build it in code with `opengraph-image.tsx` and `ImageResponse`, using the Bricolage font and dark theme.
- **Set `metadataBase`:** add your production URL in `generateMetadata` so the image link is a full URL. Social sites skip relative image links.
- **Add `twitter: { card: "summary_large_image" }`:** this makes X show the large image instead of a small square.

You could start from `docs/store-assets/heard-marquee-1400x560.png` (still uncommitted), but it's wider than 1200×630, so it would need resizing or padding. Building the image in code avoids that.
